notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Chameleon, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat each turn.
